patch.value: Reserve explicit shared resources with fenced tracker leases

Acceptance: exclusive resource ownership cannot overlap; expired or stale tokens cannot publish; backend refusal never silently falls back to local coordination. Add a backend-neutral typed SDK model, agent-sized CLI TOON/JSON, typed remedies, README and example, non-Git real public tracker copy validation, behavioral revert proof and CI npm/Bun release evidence. Builds on PR #12 and must merge after it.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: core CLI exposes item claim/release and SDK locks/workspace transactions, not named non-file resource reservations. PR #12 owns shared operation lease correctness and fenced item handoff. pm-rl process.ts reserveProcessJob reserves trainer budget allowances per job, not exclusive named environments, ports, datasets or deployment slots. This feature reuses tracker claims and #12 operation leases, adds a resource model and refuses unsupported backend coordination; no worktree lanes are added. Registry reports pm CLI 2026.10.21; tracker writes use the pinned 2026.10.17 host.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: one explicitly tagged resource item per physical slot, using native assignee plus the existing decimal swarm_token and a durable resource expiry. Reserve, renew, release and bounded publication update through the same operation lease as PR #12 claims. Resource items are excluded from work selection and stale-agent recovery. A typed ResourceBackend owns serialization and atomic publication; its refusal propagates with no fallback. The built-in local tracker adapter refuses service-capable storage configurations before creating a local operation pin. Hosted provider acceptance is not claimed.
